method: Cold parsed-font and raw glyph caches before each case, then warm API previews. API round trip includes FastAPI routing, response validation, JSON and TestClient overhead, without browser or network latency. One service export per case, including actual PNG renderer. Preview never renders PNG. Fixed 60 mm finished width; Mr Bear stays on one line.
